issues: Cookie consent banner has z-[10000] and intercepts clicks on the floating nav-menu (bottom-left) when both are stacked at the viewport bottom. Real user can dismiss it easily; only affected automation initially. Consider raising nav-menu z-index above cookie or lowering cookie once user has scrolled past — non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: BottomNav.jsx correctly gates FloatingCommand rendering; on booking pages the entire nav is hidden which is expected but means users on active-trip flows can't reach Konto/Assistent without ending the trip — verify this is intended UX.

Driver-theme scope: body.driver-theme overrides CSS vars but computed vars read from :root still return customer values. Any code reading getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--accent') in JS on driver pages will get the wrong value. If any component relies on JS-read CSS vars (charts, dynamic gradients), verify it reads from body instead.
server.py at 2052 lines still not modularized (carry-over from iter10).

Cookie banner z-index (10000) is higher than nav-sheet (1011) and nav-menu — if a user has not dismissed the cookie, they cannot open the command sheet on mobile until dismissed. Consider auto-hiding the banner in the safe area above the floating bar.
